symbols.name: polynomial
symbols.meaning: The polynomial whose coefficients are packed into one integer.
symbols.quote: Let $P(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{M-1}\gamma_i x^i$ be a polynomial in $x$, where $M$ is the number of coefficients of $P$ and $\gamma_i$ is the integer coefficient of $x^i$.

symbols.name: coefficient count
symbols.meaning: The number of coefficients of $P$, which counts its slots in the packed integer.
symbols.quote: Let $P(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{M-1}\gamma_i x^i$ be a polynomial in $x$, where $M$ is the number of coefficients of $P$ and $\gamma_i$ is the integer coefficient of $x^i$.

symbols.name: coefficient
symbols.quote: Let $P(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{M-1}\gamma_i x^i$ be a polynomial in $x$, where $M$ is the number of coefficients of $P$ and $\gamma_i$ is the integer coefficient of $x^i$.

symbols.name: slot width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits each slot holds, so each coefficient occupies a slot of this many bits.
symbols.quote: Each slot has width $\sigma$, the number of bits it holds, and each $|\gamma_i|<2^{\sigma-1}$.

symbols.name: packed integer of P
symbols.meaning: The single integer that encodes the polynomial $P$ at bit offsets of $\sigma$ bits per coefficient.
symbols.quote: The packed integer of $P$ is $N_P=P(2^\sigma)=\sum_{i=0}^{M-1}\gamma_i 2^{\sigma i}$, so coefficient $\gamma_i$ sits at bit offset $\sigma i$.

symbols.name: second polynomial
symbols.meaning: The second polynomial, whose product with $P$ is computed by one integer product.
symbols.quote: Let $Q$ be a second polynomial, with packed integer $N_Q=Q(2^\sigma)$.

symbols.name: packed integer of Q
symbols.meaning: The single integer that encodes the polynomial $Q$ in the same way as $N_P$ encodes $P$.
symbols.quote: Let $Q$ be a second polynomial, with packed integer $N_Q=Q(2^\sigma)$.

relations.quote: Signed coefficient packing turns the polynomial products of the [synthetic polynomial transform](synthetic-transform.md) into integer products, so they run on an integer multiplier.
